topic: Psychological and Social Principles of Physical Education
subject: pe

items.q: What causes muscle soreness 1-2 days after intense exercise?
items.correct: Microscopic muscle damage (DOMS), not lactic acid.
items.misconception: Lactic acid still in the muscles.
items.why: Students believe the myth that lactic acid causes soreness. Lactate clears within an hour. Delayed onset muscle soreness (DOMS) is caused by microtrauma from eccentric contractions, peaking 24-72 hours later.
The answer examiners want is: SPORT. “FITT” is the distractor this question was built around — if it tempted you, that's the exact gap to close.
It's Tapering. “Overload” is the classic near-miss here; knowing why it's wrong is worth as much as knowing the right answer.

items.q: How many letters in SPORT principle?
items.why: Exact answer: 5 letters. Estimation gets you near it; only the anchored number survives the exam hall.
